elaine: Heads-up: PM ask for a concise routing + multi-region launch playbook we can hand to eng + sales. Need clear gating, minimal customer requirements, and rollback signals. Can we sketch one here?

diego: Proposal sketch: 1) pre-canary checklist, 2) canary gating, 3) expansion gates, 4) GA criteria + post-GA observability. Keep each actionable.

maya: Pre-canary MUSTs: telemetry (per-tenant p50/p95/p99), error budget dashboard, route-level cost estimation, and runbook for region failover. Without those, stop.

owen: Canary gating: choose 3 tenants (mix of small/med/large), two regions (EU + US), run for 72h with realtime SLO burns. If SLO burn >4% in any hour for any tenant => pause.
harper: Add customer opt-in docs and a security checklist: encryption in transit, at-rest, and KMS attestation. Sales needs a template legal blurb for early customers.

diego: Expansion gates: after 72h, pass chaos test (AZ drop + 20% traffic spike), less than 0.2% customer-facing errors, and documented fallback behavior for model variants.

infra-bot: runbook-check: chaos-sim job queued (id=77312)

elaine: Can we require a routing policy taxonomy doc: what "prefer-local", "regional-pool", and "global-fallback" actually mean (ordering, weights, TTLs)? Sales wants something they can show customers.

maya: Yes. Also document model-compatibility matrix: which quantized variants can be used as fallbacks without semantic regressions for common prompt classes.

owen: Operational metric: MTTR <= 20m for routing-induced outages during canary. If we exceed, require postmortem and targeted mitigations before expanding.
harper: Compliance note: for Private/EU customers, KMS integration + residency mapping must be signed off by security. Blocker for production enablement.

diego: Add cost control: projected per-token cost for routed fallbacks must be within 1.4x baseline or flagged. Finance will require an approval for any >1.4x.

sales-ops: For GTM: need a shortlist of feature-callouts: deterministic routing SLAs, region pinning for models, and clear migration paths. Also a pre-approved FAQ for customers about what "isolation" means.

elaine: Rollback triggers (explicit): sustained customer error rate >0.5% for 30m, or cross-region failover latency >2s for 15m, or SLO burn >10% in any 1h window. Those should cause automated rollback plan to run.

maya: Add automated alerting to the customer: if their errors spike due to routing changes, we notify and offer immediate opt-out switch.

owen: For GA criteria: run in 4 regions, 10 paying customers >5k req/day across regions, no critical incidents in last 30 days, cost within cap, and signed compliance docs for private customers.
harper: Post-GA: ensure per-tenant dashboards, billing transparency (token-level cost), and a migration guide for customers wanting to pin or migrate off the global-fallback.

diego: One more: we should capture a short migration playbook for tenants moving from shared -> isolated lanes (acceptance tests, data handling, DNS cutover steps).

infra-bot: deploy: canary rollout started to us-east and eu-west at 1763204400 for tenant-group "playbook-beta"

elaine: OK I'll convert this sketch into a terse 1-pager + gating matrix. Will include links to runbooks and the model-compat matrix. Posting PR in ~12h. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
